title.en: Sample page: how this diary works
title.zh: 示例页：这本日记怎么用

body.en:
This is a sample entry. Open the site with ?write at the end of the address to write new pages; they are kept in your browser until you press Export and replace site/diary.json with the downloaded file.

Each page remembers the season, weather and time of day the room was in when you wrote it.
body.zh:
这是一篇示例日记。在网址末尾加上 ?write 打开网站即可写新的一页；内容先保存在你的浏览器里，按“导出”后用下载的文件替换 site/diary.json 即可发布。

每一页都会记下写它时房间里的季节、天气和时间。

body.en: A second sample, so the page turn has somewhere to go. Delete both when you add your own.
body.zh: 第二篇示例，让翻页有地方可翻。写下自己的日记后，把这两篇删掉即可。
